changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.31
- New fireteam card at the bottom of the Control Center: shows your current Destiny activity, a live timer, and your fireteam (names + emblems). Uses your Bungie ID over the public Bungie API - no login needed. (Live fireteam needs your Bungie activity privacy set to public.)
- New "Badge size" slider in Settings > Overlay Details: scale the in-game port badges up or down while keeping their proportions.
- Leaderboards: rank numbers now line up consistently (10th place and up no longer crowd the name).
- Fixed a dark rectangle that could flash behind a module badge the first time you ticked it.
